title: Running Commentary on Torah 17 — Va'yehi Heim M'rikim Sakeihem
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 17 — ויהי הם מריקים שקיהם
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: Opening pesukim — decoded only at the end: **"Va'yehi heim m'rikim sakeihem, v'hinei ish tzror kaspo b'sako; va'yiru es tz'roros kaspeihem heimah va'avihem, va'yira'u. Va'yomer lahem Yaakov avihem: osi shikaltem — Yosef einenu, v'Shimon einenu, v'es Binyamin tikachu! Alai hayu kulanah"** (Bereshis 42:35-36). Decoded at end: **m'rikim sakeihem = emptying the sack of darkened yirah/ahavah; ish tzror kaspo b'sako = the tzaddik whose light is darkened and clothed in sack; Yosef = "hon yosif rei'im rabim"; Shimon = "v'shim'o holech"; Binyamin = mizbei'ach b'chelko shel toref**.

intermediate.en: **Opening pesukim**: **"Va'yehi heim m'rikim sakeihem... Yosef einenu, Shimon einenu, Binyamin tikachu"** (Ber 42:35-36). Decoded: **m'rikim sakeihem**=emptying darkened yirah/ahavah; **ish tzror kaspo b'sako**=tzaddik's light darkened; **Yosef**="hon yosif rei'im"; **Shimon**="shim'o holech"; **Binyamin**=mizbei'ach shel toref.
intermediate.he: **פסוקי פתיחה**: **"ויהי הם מריקים שקיהם... יוסף איננו, שמעון איננו, ואת בנימין תקחו"** (בר' מב, לה-לו). פענוח: **מריקים שקיהם**=ריקון יראה/אהבה שהתחשכו; **איש צרור כספו בשקו**=אור הצדיק התחשך; **יוסף**="הון יוסיף רעים"; **שמעון**="שמעו הולך"; **בנימין**=מזבח של טורף.

scholarly.he: בר' מב, לה-לו — פתיחה.

intermediate.en: **"א"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"א"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף א.

beginner.en: **"Yirah and ahavah cannot be received except through **tzaddikei ha'dor**, for the tzaddik ha'dor is the one who reveals yirah and ahavah."**

intermediate.en: **Yirah + ahavah only via tzaddikei ha'dor** (the revealer).
intermediate.he: **יראה + אהבה רק דרך צדיקי הדור** (המגלה).

scholarly.he: יראה/אהבה = דרך צדיק.

beginner.en: **"The tzaddik constantly searches and seeks to reveal the **retzonos** (wills) of Hashem. For in every thing there is a **retzon Hashem** — both in the **klal of creation** (that Hashem wanted to create the world in general) and in the **perat of every single thing** (each in its specific form, power, nature). Why did Hashem want the lion to have such strength and such form? Why is a little gnat so weak? And even within one creature: why this limb, this shape, this function — and another limb different?"** **"The tzaddik constantly seeks these retzonos, attaining them through the **hispa'arus** (glory/delight) that he finds in Israel — in general and in detail and in the details of details. Because the entire world was created only for Israel: **'Bereshis — bishvil Yisrael she'nikre'u reishis'** (Vayikra Rabbah 36:4); **'Yisrael alu b'machshavah techilah'** (Bereshis Rabbah 1:4). Hashem foresaw the hispa'arus and sha'ashu'im He would receive from Israel: **'Yisrael asher becha espa'er'** (Yeshayahu 49:3) — for this He created the world. **Klal ha'briyah** was for **klal hispa'arus of klal Yisrael**; **perat** for **perat of each Jew's hispa'arus**, **pratei pratiyos** for every limb, every motion — even the lowest Jew, even **poshei Yisrael** (while name Yisrael is on him). Even the pe'os-shake of the simplest Jew gives Hashem hispa'arus. When the tzaddik knows and finds the hispa'arus in every detail, **he knows all the retzonos Hashem had in the briyah**, since every retzon corresponded to a particular hispa'arus."** **"The hispa'arus = shoresh of the briyah."** **"Via this revelation of hispa'arus, yirah and ahavah are revealed. For through revelation of hispa'arus — yirah falls. As Israel's hispa'arus = **tefillin** (called 'pe'er,' Berachos 11a) — and via tefillin yirah is revealed: **'v'ra'u kol amei ha'aretz ki shem Hashem nikra alecha, v'yar'u mimecha'** (Devarim 28:10; Berachos 6a — 'these are tefillin shel rosh'). So too Hashem's hispa'arus in Israel = **tefillin of HKBH** (Berachos 6a: 'minayin she'HKBH maniach tefillin?') — tefillin of the Ribon Olam contain: **'mi k'amcha Yisrael... mi goy gadol'**"** (the praise of Israel). **"Through this hispa'arus, **yiraso yisbarach** is revealed even on **shinanei shechak** (the celestial beings). For though all always fear before the King, on **yom gnusya d'malka** (the king's coronation day), when he dons **bigdei hispa'arus**, yirah is revealed more. Sensory seeing of glory overwhelms more than mere knowing. When the tzaddik reveals hispa'arus, it is bechina of **yom gnusya d'malka** — for essential malchus = via Israel accepting it: **ein melech b'lo am**."**

intermediate.en: **Tzaddik seeks retzonos Hashem in every detail of creation** — attained via the **hispa'arus** in Israel (klal/perat/pratei pratiyos). Every creature's form, power, nature = specific retzon = specific hispa'arus in a Jew (every limb/motion; even pe'os-shake; even poshei Yisrael). **Hispa'arus = shoresh briyah**. World created for Israel ("bishvil Yisrael," VR 36:4; "alu b'machshavah," BR 1:4; Yesh 49:3). **Israel's hispa'arus = tefillin of pe'er** (Ber 11a) → yirah (Dev 28:10; Ber 6a). Hashem's hispa'arus = **tefillin of Ribon Olam** (Ber 6a — "minayin she'HKBH maniach tefillin?" — contain "mi k'amcha Yisrael"). Revelation = **yom gnusya d'malka**: all fear deepens through sensory seeing of bigdei hispa'arus; Israel receives malchus ("ein melech b'lo am").
intermediate.he: **הצדיק מחפש רצונות ה' בכל פרט בבריאה** — ע"י ה**התפארות** בישראל (כלל/פרט/פרטי פרטיות). צורת/כוח/טבע כל ברייה = רצון פרטי = התפארות פרטית ביהודי (כל אבר/תנועה; אפילו נענוע פאה; אפילו פושעי ישראל). **התפארות = שורש הבריאה**. העולם נברא לישראל ("בשביל ישראל", ויק"ר לו, ד; "עלו במחשבה", ב"ר א, ד; יש' מט, ג). **התפארות ישראל = תפילין של פאר** (בר' יא.) → יראה (דב' כח, י; בר' ו.). התפארות ה' = **תפילין של ריבון עולם** (בר' ו. — "מנין שהקב"ה מניח תפילין?" — מכילים "מי כעמך ישראל"). גילוי = **יום גנוסיא דמלכא**: יראה מתגברת בראיה חושית של בגדי התפארות; ישראל מקבלים מלכות ("אין מלך בלא עם").

scholarly.he: צדיק/רצונות/התפארות כלל+פרט+פרט"פ. בשביל ישראל (ויק"ר לו, ד; ב"ר א, ד; יש' מט, ג). תפילין=פאר (בר' יא.; ו.; דב' כח, י). יום גנוסיא דמלכא — ראיה חושית; אין מלך בלא עם.

beginner.en: **"And then on **yom gnusya d'malka** = revelation of Israel's hispa'arus — the yirah falls on all, even **shinanei shechak**. Bechina of: **'al Yisrael ga'avaso'** (Tehillim 68:35) — when His ga'avah is revealed on Israel — **'v'uzo ba'shechakim'** — 'oz = yirah' (as above, tefillin)."** **"Via revelation of hispa'arus = revelation of yirah, is revealed the **ratzon = ahavah**. Because on yom gnusya d'malka after the yirah falls, the king reveals his ratzon to each one, distributes gifts to each per his honor — that is **ahavah**. Each retzon Hashem in the briyah corresponds to a hispa'arus-detail; so too the ratzon-after-yirah = ahavah-close."** **"**'Ki tif'eres uzamo atah, u'vi'rtzoncha tarum karneinu'** (Tehillim 89:18). **Tif'eres uzamo** = yirah that comes from hispa'arus; **u'vi'rtzoncha tarum karneinu** = ahavah. Thus the tzaddik reveals yirah **and** ahavah."**

intermediate.en: **Yom gnusya d'malka** = revelation of Israel's hispa'arus → yirah on all, even **shinanei shechak** ("al Yisrael ga'avaso... v'uzo ba'shechakim," Teh 68:35; oz=yirah). Then king reveals **ratzon → ahavah** (gifts per honor). **"Ki tif'eres uzamo atah, u'vi'rtzoncha tarum karneinu"** (Teh 89:18): tif'eres/oz=yirah; ratzoncha tarum karnam=ahavah. Tzaddik reveals both.
intermediate.he: **יום גנוסיא דמלכא** = גילוי התפארות ישראל → יראה על כולם, אפילו **שנאני שחק** ("על ישראל גאוותו... ועוזו בשחקים", תה' סח, לה; עוז=יראה). אז המלך מגלה **רצון → אהבה** (מתנות לפי כבוד). **"כי תפארת עוזמו אתה, וברצונך תרום קרנינו"** (תה' פט, יח): תפארת/עוז=יראה; רצונך/קרן=אהבה. הצדיק מגלה שניהם.

scholarly.he: יום גנוסיא — יראה/אהבה. תה' סח, לה; פט, יח.

intermediate.en: **"ב"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ב"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב.

beginner.en: **"When one's yirah and ahavah are darkened — bechina of **'alvish shamayim kadrus v'sak asim k'susam'** (Yeshayahu 50:3). **'Shamayim' = esh+mayim = yirah + ahavah** clothed in kadrus and sack — because the **light of the tzaddik** from whom one receives yirah and ahavah is darkened."** **"Sometimes the tzaddik's light is darkened to one person — he cannot taste, understand, see, the tzaddik's great light, though he is by the tzaddik. Like **Efron** (Zohar Chayei Sarah 128) — although Me'aras ha'Machpelah is **the gate of Gan Eden** through which all neshamos ascend, for Efron it was a place of **choshech v'afelah** — hence he sold it to Avraham joyously."** **"This is **achirus ha'ma'asim + k'silus ha'sechel**. Bad deeds darken the sechel with **k'silus = de'os nifsados v'chochmos nochriyos** — 'chachamim hemah l'hara u'l'heitiv lo yada'u' (Yirmiyahu 4:22). Thus one can't see the tzaddik's light."**

intermediate.en: **Darkened yirah+ahavah** ("alvish shamayim kadrus v'sak," Yesh 50:3; shamayim=esh+mayim=yirah+ahavah) = **tzaddik's light darkened**. **Efron** (Zohar Chayei Sarah 128): Me'aras haMachpelah=gate of Gan Eden, yet to him choshech (hence sold it joyously). Cause: **achirus ma'asim + k'silus ha'sechel** ("chachamim l'hara u'l'heitiv lo yada'u," Yir 4:22).
intermediate.he: **יראה+אהבה מתחשכות** ("אלביש שמים קדרות ושק", יש' נ, ג; שמים=אש+מים=יראה+אהבה) = **אור הצדיק מתחשך**. **עפרון** (זוה"ק חיי שרה קכח): מערת המכפלה=שער גן עדן, ואצלו חושך (לכן מכר בשמחה). סיבה: **עכירות המעשים + כסילות השכל** ("חכמים המה להרע ולהיטיב לא ידעו", יר' ד, כב).

scholarly.he: יראה/אהבה חשוכות (יש' נ, ג); אור הצדיק; עפרון (זוה"ק חיי שרה קכח); יר' ד, כב.

beginner.en: **"ג. The tikkun to subdue and nullify **k'silus ha'sechel** = via the **mizbei'ach** — since the klipos/k'silus draw only from the mizbei'ach (Zohar Terumah 139) = bechina of **achilah** ('shulchano shel adam m'chaper ka'mizbei'ach,' Berachos 55a), from there is their ikar yenikah."** **"Even a kosher person has some bilbul da'as after eating — this is why."** **"Must give klipos only **kdei chiyuto b'tzimtzum, not more**. Then when mizbei'ach is in order — achilah in kashrus — klipos/k'silus subdued."** **"Gemara (Bava Kama 72a): R' Nachman to Rava — 'l'tzafra amar lei... v'hai d'lo amri lach b'orta — d'lo achli bisra d'tora' — 'because I hadn't eaten beef' — i.e., without eating, da'as not clear; via eating, k'silus subdued, sechel grows."** **"Zolel v'sove'a = pgam mizbei'ach → klipos draw more → k'silus overpowers sechel."** **"Zevachim 53a: **'mizbei'ach b'chelko shel toref'** — bechina of **'teref nasan li'reiav'** (Tehillim 111:5) = eating in kashrus — subdues/tears klipos. Pgam mizbei'ach → **m'toref = t'ruf ha'da'as**."**

intermediate.en: **ג. Tikkun of k'silus = mizbei'ach/achilah** (shulchan shel adam, Ber 55a; klipot yenikah, Zohar Terumah 139). Give klipos only kdei chiyuto b'tzimtzum. Kashrus → sechel grows (BK 72a R' Nachman/Rava "d'lo achli bisra d'tora"). Zolel v'sove'a=pgam. Zev 53a: **"mizbei'ach b'chelko shel toref"** = "teref nasan li'reiav" (Teh 111:5); pgam→**t'ruf ha'da'as**.
intermediate.he: **ג. תיקון כסילות = מזבח/אכילה** (שולחן האדם, בר' נה.; יניקת קליפות, זוה"ק תרומה קלט). לתת לקליפות רק כדי חיותו בצמצום. כשרות → שכל גדל (ב"ק עב. ר"נ/רבא "דלא אכלי בשרא דתורא"). זולל וסובא=פגם. זב' נג.: **"מזבח בחלקו של טורף"** = "טרף נתן ליראיו" (תה' קיא, ה); פגם→**טירוף הדעת**.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. מזבח/אכילה (בר' נה.; זוה"ק תרומה קלט); ב"ק עב.; זב' נג.; תה' קיא, ה.

beginner.en: **"ד. To complete **pgam ha'mizbei'ach** = via **gerim**. All AZ's power = from pgam ha'mizbei'ach. **'B'chol makom muktar u'mugash li'shmi'** (Mal'achi 1:11) — even AZ-worshippers draw power from the **nitzotz kadosh** of the mizbei'ach d'kedushah that fell into their hands. Via gerim throwing off their emunah — AZ-from-pgam-mizbei'ach is subdued, nitzotzos return to place, mizbei'ach is completed."**

intermediate.en: **ד. Complete pgam mizbei'ach via gerim.** AZ power = from pgam (**"b'chol makom muktar u'mugash li'shmi,"** Mal 1:11 = nitzotz of mizbei'ach). Gerim → AZ subdued, nitzotzos return.
intermediate.he: **ד. השלמת פגם מזבח ע"י גרים.** כוח ע"ז = מהפגם (**"בכל מקום מוקטר ומוגש לשמי",** מל' א, יא = ניצוץ מהמזבח). גרים → ביטול ע"ז, ניצוצות חוזרים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. גרים משלימים פגם מזבח (מל' א, יא).

beginner.en: **"**'Lo yishkav ad yochal teref, v'dam chalalim yishteh'** (Bamidbar 23:24) — Targum: **'v'nichsei amma'ya yeiras'** (will inherit the property of peoples). **Yochal teref** = completion of mizbei'ach = 'mizbei'ach b'chelko shel toref.' This happens via **'v'nichsei amma'ya yeiras'** = via **gerim** — Chazal (Bava Basra 42a, 53b, 149a, etc.): **'kol ha'kodem bi'nichsei ha'ger zachah'** (on inheritance of a ger)."**

intermediate.en: **"Lo yishkav ad yochal teref, v'dam chalalim yishteh"** (Bam 23:24; Tg **"v'nichsei amma'ya yeiras"**): **yochal teref**=mizbei'ach shleimus (toref); via **v'nichsei=gerim** ("kol ha'kodem bi'nichsei ha'ger," BB 42a/53b/149a).
intermediate.he: **"לא ישכב עד יאכל טרף, ודם חללים ישתה"** (במ' כג, כד; ת"א **"ונכסי עממיא יירת"**): **יאכל טרף**=שלמות מזבח (טורף); ע"י **ונכסי=גרים** ("כל הקודם בנכסי הגר", ב"ב מב./נג:/קמט.).

scholarly.he: במ' כג, כד; ת"א; ב"ב מב./נג:/קמט.

intermediate.en: **"ה"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ה"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה.

beginner.en: **"How to make gerim — they're so far from kedushas Yisrael? Via bechina of **'hon yosif rei'im rabim'** (Mishlei 19:4) — via **tzedakah** given to a **talmid chacham** who contains many nafshos Yisrael."** **"Just as distance between people requires **kesav** to be heard — so one must send bechina of **kesav** to them. The primary **chush ha'shemi'ah** works through **letters of dibbur carved into the air**, air striking air until it reaches the ear. When **avir is nach v'zach v'tzalul** (calm, pure, clear), speech carries far; when there's **ru'ach se'arah**, it's broken up and scatters."**

intermediate.en: **How to make gerim despite distance**: **"hon yosif rei'im rabim"** (Mishlei 19:4) = tzedakah to TCh containing many nafshos. **Kesav** crosses distance. Speech carries via **avir nach v'zach** (sha'ar ha'shemi'ah: letters carve air); **ru'ach se'arah** scatters.
intermediate.he: **איך לעשות גרים מרחוק**: **"הון יוסיף רעים רבים"** (מש' יט, ד) = צדקה לת"ח הכולל נפשות רבות. **כתב** חוצה מרחק. דיבור עובר באויר ע"י **אויר נח וזך** (שער שמיעה: אותיות חוקקות באויר); **רוח סערה** מפזר.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. הון יוסיף (מש' יט, ד); אויר נח/רוח סערה.

beginner.en: **"Via tzedakah one **lokei'ach nefashos** — acquiring friends/lovers. Monbaz (Bava Basra 11a): **'avosai ganzu mamon, v'ani ganazti nefashos'** — 'my fathers stored money; I stored souls.' More tzedakah to more people = more rei'im — and **love purifies the air**."** **"**Ahavah = hisdabkus rucha b'rucha** (spirit of lover in spirit of beloved) = **avir ha'nach** (their ruchos at rest, no ruach ra'ah of sin'ah to separate). **Sin'ah = ru'ach ra'ah** — 'va'yasem Hashem ru'ach ra'ah bein Avimelech u'vein anshei Shechem' (Shoftim 9:23) — Rashi: 'sin'ah.' Sin'ah = bilbul avir, speech blocked. **Ahavah/re'us = avir nach v'zach**, speech carries far."**

intermediate.en: **Tzedakah lokei'ach nefashos** — Monbaz (BB 11a "avosai ganzu mamon, ani ganazti nefashos"). Ahavah=**hisdabkus rucha b'rucha**=avir nach (no ra'ah=sin'ah separating). Sin'ah=ru'ach ra'ah (Shoft 9:23 Rashi)=bilbul avir. Ahavah=avir zach → speech carries.
intermediate.he: **צדקה לוקחת נפשות** — מונבז (ב"ב יא. "אבותי גנזו ממון, אני גנזתי נפשות"). אהבה=**התדבקות רוחא ברוחא**=אויר נח (ללא רעה=שנאה מפרידה). שנאה=רוח רעה (שופ' ט, כג רש"י)=בלבול אויר. אהבה=אויר זך → דיבור נישא.

scholarly.he: ב"ב יא. מונבז; שופ' ט, כג רש"י.

beginner.en: **"The more tzedakah to more people, more **shetach** of avir nach; one person = small patch; two = larger; many = great expanse. Therefore: primarily **give tzedakah to tzaddikei emes and to aniyim hagunim** who are **k'lulim mi'kamah nafshos Yisrael** — one gift enlarges the shetach greatly."**

intermediate.en: More people + tzedakah = larger **shetach** of avir nach. **Primarily to tzaddikei emes + aniyim hagunim** (k'lulim mi'kamah nafshos) — one gift = great shetach.
intermediate.he: יותר אנשים + צדקה = **שטח** גדול יותר של אויר נח. **עיקר לצדיקי אמת + עניים הגונים** (כלולים מכמה נפשות) — מתנה אחת = שטח גדול.

scholarly.he: שטח אויר נח; צדיקים/עניים הגונים.

beginner.en: **"When avir is nach v'zach, when one speaks the **dibbur ha'Yisraeli (dibbur kadosh)**, it is written and engraved in the avir — **'leshoni et sofer mahir'** (Tehillim 45:2). The dibbur goes and is heard far — **'v'shom'o holech b'chol ha'medinos'** (Esther 9:4). The dibbur is written in the nations' books, medinah u'medinah ki'chesavah. Then the nations find in their books **hefech emunasam** — as many gerim became so: they found in their books the contrary of their faith. How? Via the tzaddik's dibbur engraved in the purified air."**

intermediate.en: **Avir nach + dibbur kadosh** → **"leshoni et sofer mahir"** (Teh 45:2); **"shom'o holech b'chol ha'medinos"** (Esther 9:4) → engraved in nations' books **hefech emunasam** → gerim convert.
intermediate.he: **אויר נח + דיבור קדוש** → **"לשוני עט סופר מהיר"** (תה' מה, ב); **"שמעו הולך בכל המדינות"** (אס' ט, ד) → נכתב בספרי האומות **היפך אמונתם** → גרים.

scholarly.he: תה' מה, ב; אס' ט, ד.

beginner.en: **"**'Va'yimatzei kasuv asher higid Mordechai'** (Esther 6:2) — **Mordechai** = kfirah in AZ, **'ish Yehudi'** — Chazal (Megillah 13a): 'kol ha'kofer ba'AZ nikra Yehudi.' Dibburim higid Mordechai = dibburim of kfiras AZ, written in the air — found in their books. **'V'rabim mei'amei ha'aretz misyahadim'** (Esther 8:17)."**

intermediate.en: **"Va'yimatzei kasuv asher higid Mordechai"** (Esther 6:2): Mordechai=kfiras AZ ("ish Yehudi," Meg 13a "kol ha'kofer b'AZ nikra Yehudi"); dibbur in their books → **"v'rabim misyahadim"** (Esther 8:17).
intermediate.he: **"וימצא כתוב אשר הגיד מרדכי"** (אס' ו, ב): מרדכי=כפירת ע"ז ("איש יהודי", מג' יג. "כל הכופר בע"ז נקרא יהודי"); דיבור בספרם → **"ורבים מתייהדים"** (אס' ח, יז).

scholarly.he: אס' ו, ב; ח, יז; מג' יג.

beginner.en:
**ו.** The Rebbe raises the obvious question: **"M'ayin ba, she'eilu dayka yimtze'u b'sifreihem hefech emunasam v'yachz'ru v'yakiru emunas Yisrael, v'ha'acherim einam motz'im k'lal v'nish'arim b'emunasam?"** — 'From where does it come that **these particular** non-Jews find in their books the opposite of their [false] beliefs and return and recognize the faith of Israel, while others find nothing at all and remain in their false faith?'

**The Rebbe's answer:** **"Zeh m'chamas b'chinas ha-tov ha-kavush tachas yadam"** -- 'this is because of the aspect of **the good that is captive under their hand**' -- meaning the **chelkei neshamos Yisrael** (portions of Jewish souls) captive with them. The reasoning: **"kol ha-tov hu rak b'chinas nishmos Yisrael"** -- all good in the world is only the aspect of souls of Israel.

**How does this captivity happen?** When the **akum mis'gabrim** (nations overpower) and **einam manichim l'Yisrael la'asos mitzvos** (do not permit Israel to perform mitzvos) -- as there were historical decrees **sheh'lo yamulu es b'neihem** (not to circumcise their sons) **v'sheh-y'chal'lu es ha-Shabbos** (and to desecrate Shabbos) -- see Rosh HaShanah 19a, Bava Basra 60a, Me'ilah 17a (the Roman/Greek decrees of persecution). When that happens, **the good that Israel needed to do is itself captive under their hand** -- because every mitzvah unperformed leaves its neshamah-portion stuck with the oppressor.

**Extended principle:** Even when they do not directly forbid mitzvos, the same result occurs **al yedei g'rama she'gor'min** (by indirect causation) -- **al yedei ha-masim v'arnonios she'matilim aleihem** (through the taxes and levies they impose on them), which consume a Jew's time and energy so he cannot serve Hashem properly. **V'chen al yedei she'monin tovos mi'Yisrael** -- and similarly by preventing benefits from reaching Israel (blocking livelihood, blocking peace, blocking chessed) -- **al yedei kol zeh nichbash ha-tov tachas yadam** -- through all this the good is captive under their hand, which means **chelkei neshamos Yisrael** are captive.

**The deep principle:** The good in a Jewish soul, when prevented from expressing itself in mitzvah, does not disappear -- it gets siphoned to whoever caused the prevention. That captive portion of Jewish soul, stuck inside the sefarim of the umah, is what eventually **whispers the truth** to those particular individuals when they open those books -- and they return to the faith of Israel, while their fellow gentiles who have no captive Jewish sparks in their sefarim find nothing.

intermediate.en: **ו. Question:** **"M'ayin ba she'eilu dayka yimtze'u b'sifreihem hefech emunasam"** -- why do **specifically these** non-Jews find truth in their own books and convert, while others don't? **Answer: b'chinas ha-tov ha-kavush tachas yadam** = **chelkei neshamos Yisrael** held captive with them (all good = souls of Israel). Captivity happens via: (1) decrees preventing mitzvos -- e.g., no milah, no Shabbos (**RH 19a; BB 60a; Me'ilah 17a**); (2) **g'rama** -- taxes/arnonios (levies) consuming a Jew's time/energy; (3) blocking **tovos** (benefits/livelihood/peace) from reaching Israel. All three mechanisms siphon the good (= neshamah-portions) into the oppressor. Those captive sparks are what whisper truth to specific individuals reading the umah's sefarim, drawing them to emunas Yisrael; others find nothing because no sparks are captive there.
intermediate.he: **ו. קושיה:** **"מאין בא שאלו דייקא ימצאו בספריהם הפך אמונתם"** -- מדוע **דווקא אלו** האומות מוצאים אמת בספריהם ומתגיירים, ואחרים לא? **תשובה: בחינת הטוב הכבוש תחת ידם** = **חלקי נשמות ישראל** הכבושים אצלם (כל טוב = נשמות ישראל). דרכי הכבישה: (1) גזרות על מצוות -- מילה, שבת (**ר"ה יט.; ב"ב ס.; מעילה יז.**); (2) **גרמא** -- מיסים וארנוניות הגוזלים זמן וכוח יהודי; (3) מניעת **טובות** (פרנסה/שלום/חסד) מישראל. שלוש דרכים אלו שואבות את הטוב (= חלקי נשמות) אל המדכא. הניצוצות השבויים הללו הם הלוחשים אמת ליחידים הקוראים בספרי האומה ומושכים אותם לאמונת ישראל; אחרים לא מוצאים כלום כי אין שם ניצוצות שבויים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. קושיית הרבי: למה דווקא אלו מוצאים בספריהם. תירוץ: הטוב הכבוש = חלקי נשמות ישראל. גזרות: מילה/שבת (ר"ה יט.; ב"ב ס.; מעילה יז.). גרמא: מיסים/ארנוניות. מניעת טובות.

beginner.en: **"Why do these specific ones find in their books the contrary of their faith, while others don't? Because of the **good captive beneath their hand** — bechina of **chalkei nishmos Yisrael** captive among them."** **"All good = bechina of nishmos Yisrael. When the umos prevent Israel from doing mitzvos (as when decrees forbade mohel or kept Shabbos: Rosh Hashanah 19a; Bava Basra 60a; Me'ilah 17a) — the good that Israel should do is captive under their hand. Or when they prevent via taxes/arnunios, or block goodness from Israel — the good (= chalkei nishmos Yisrael) is **captive**."**

intermediate.en: **The good captive** (chalkei nishmos Yisrael) = cause some umos find hefech emunasam. Persecution (decrees, taxes): Israel's good works/neshamos captive (RH 19a; BB 60a; Me'ilah 17a).
intermediate.he: **הטוב הכבוש** (חלקי נשמות ישראל) = סיבה מדוע אומות מסוימות מוצאות היפך אמונתן. רדיפות (גזירות/מיסים): מצוות/נשמות ישראל כבושות (ר"ה יט.; ב"ב ס.; מעיל' יז.).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. טוב כבוש; ר"ה יט.; ב"ב ס.; מעיל' יז.

beginner.en: **"Initially this captive good remembers its supernal source; but they overpower it, bind it, until the good itself **forgets its height**. When the dibbur Yisraeli enters their books (as above), the captive good finds the hefech emunah there — and remembers its height: that it is chalkei nishmos Yisrael for whose sake all worlds were created, **'heimah ha'yotzerim v'yoshvei netaim im ha'melech bi'mlachto'** (Divrei Ha'Yamim I 4:23) — 'HKBH took counsel with nishmos Yisrael in creating the world' (Bereshis 8; Midrash Rut 2). Then the good longs to return — but because of the deep bonds, when it tears itself loose it drags some of **their evil along with it**. That evil dragged along with the good = the **gerim**."**

intermediate.en: Captive good → forgets height → dibbur writes in books → good remembers (created-with-HKBH, Divrei Ha'Yamim I 4:23 "im ha'melech bi'mlachto"; BR 8; Midrash Rut 2) → tearing free drags **some of their evil** = **the gerim**.
intermediate.he: הטוב כבוש → שוכח מעלתו → דיבור בספרים → נזכר (נמלך, דה"א ד, כג "עם המלך במלאכתו"; ב"ר ח; מד"ר ב) → בתלישה גורר **רע** = **גרים**.

scholarly.he: טוב כבוש; דה"א ד, כג; ב"ר ח; מדרש רות ב.

beginner.en: **"**'Zeh yichtov yado la'Hashem'** (Yeshayahu 44:5) — Rashi: **'ba'alei teshuvah'** = the good returning to its place via **kesav**: 'va'yimatzei kasuv asher higid Mordechai.' **'U'v'shem Yisrael y'chaneh'** = **gerim**: when good returns, gerim are made."**

intermediate.en: **"Zeh yichtov yado la'Hashem"** (Yesh 44:5; Rashi: ba'alei teshuvah) = good returning via kesav. **"U'v'shem Yisrael y'chaneh"** = gerim.
intermediate.he: **"זה יכתוב ידו לה'"** (יש' מד, ה; רש"י: ב"ת) = טוב חוזר דרך כתב. **"ובשם ישראל יכנה"** = גרים.

scholarly.he: יש' מד, ה (רש"י).

beginner.en: **"**'Bi'ch'sav Yisrael lo yikaseivu v'el admas Yisrael lo yavo'u'** (Yechezkel 13:9) — when no bechina of kesav Yisrael, no gerim — then no 'admas Yisrael' = no **mizbei'ach adamah** (Shemos 20:21; Bereshis Rabbah 14) which is completed via gerim."**

intermediate.en: **"Bi'ch'sav Yisrael lo yikaseivu v'el admas Yisrael lo yavo'u"** (Yech 13:9): no kesav → no gerim → no **mizbei'ach adamah** (Shem 20:21; BR 14).
intermediate.he: **"בכתב ישראל לא ייכתבו ואל אדמת ישראל לא יבואו"** (יחז' יג, ט): אין כתב → אין גרים → אין **מזבח אדמה** (שמ' כ, כא; ב"ר יד).

scholarly.he: יחז' יג, ט; שמ' כ, כא; ב"ר יד.

beginner.en: **"**'Ha'kol bi'chsav mi'yad Hashem, alay hiskil'** (Divrei Ha'Yamim I 28:19). Shleimus ha'sechel is via **kesav** (as above): kesav → gerim → mizbei'ach complete → sechel complete."**

intermediate.en: **"Ha'kol bi'chsav mi'yad Hashem, alay hiskil"** (Divrei I 28:19): chain kesav→gerim→mizbei'ach→sechel.
intermediate.he: **"הכל בכתב מיד ה' עלי השכיל"** (דה"א כח, יט): שרשרת כתב→גרים→מזבח→שכל.

scholarly.he: דה"א כח, יט.

beginner.en: **"**'L'sakein olam b'Malchus Shaddai, v'chol b'nei basar yikre'u vi'shmecha, l'hafnos elecha kol rishei aretz, yakiru v'yeid'u kol yoshvei seivel'** (from *Aleinu*). **'B'Malchus Shaddai'** = teshuvah: good returns to place. **Shaddai** = teshuvah on pgam AZ — 'sheyesh dai b'Elokuso l'chol briyah' (Rashi Lech Lecha 17). **'L'hafnos... rishei aretz'** = gerim. **'Yakiru v'yeid'u'** = shleimus ha'da'as."**

intermediate.en: **Aleinu**: **"L'sakein olam b'Malchus Shaddai"**=teshuvah (Shaddai=dai b'Elokuso, Rashi Lech Lecha 17). **"Kol rishei aretz"**=gerim. **"Yakiru v'yeid'u"**=shleimus da'as.
intermediate.he: **עלינו**: **"לתקן עולם במלכות שד'"**=תשובה (שד'=די באלוקותי, רש"י לך לך יז). **"כל רשעי ארץ"**=גרים. **"יכירו וידעו"**=שלמות דעת.

scholarly.he: עלינו: מלכות שדי (רש"י לך לך יז); רשעי ארץ=גרים; יכירו=דעת.

beginner.en: **"**'V'hayah Shaddai b'tzarecha v'chesef toafos lach'** (Iyov 22:25). Via **kesef toafos** = bechina of 'hon yosif rei'im rabim' — **avir meofeif = nizdakech** → made **Shaddai** = teshuvah + gerim."**

intermediate.en: **"V'hayah Shaddai b'tzarecha v'chesef toafos lach"** (Iyov 22:25): kesef toafos="hon yosif" → avir meofeif/nizdakech → Shaddai=teshuvah+gerim.
intermediate.he: **"והיה שדי בצריך וכסף תועפות לך"** (איוב כב, כה): כסף תועפות="הון יוסיף" → אויר מעופף/נזדכך → שדי=תשובה+גרים.

scholarly.he: איוב כב, כה.

intermediate.en: **"ז"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ז"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז.

beginner.en: **"Sometimes when the ra sees the tov yearning to return, they **overpower it and draw it into deeper concealment** — into their **inner thoughts/brain (penimiyus machshavasam)**. They begin to **think thoughts** about this good (plotting against it), thereby hiding it deeper in their machshavah/mo'ach."** **"Then the good exits **via birth** (holadah) — since the good is hidden in their penimiyus mo'ach, from there comes birth — hence **the good emerges in the zera of the offspring**. The **ra of the children has no power** to overcome the good; so the good exits via the children, and **they become gerim**."**

intermediate.en: **ז. Ra overpowers → draws good into penimiyus machshavah (plotting → mo'ach)** → good exits **via holadah** (seed of children); children's ra too weak → gerim.
intermediate.he: **ז. רע מתגבר → גורר טוב לפנימיות מחשבה (חישוב → מוח)** → יציאת הטוב **ע"י הולדה** (זרע הילדים); רע הילדים חלש → גרים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. פנימיות מחשבה → הולדה → גרים.

beginner.en: **"**'Hashem yispor bi'chsov amim, zeh yulad sham, selah'** (Tehillim 87:6). **'Bi'chsov'** = good emerging via kesav. **'Zeh yulad sham'** = good clothed in children. Rashi: 'zeh yulad sham = Yisrael she'nitam'u b'akum' = the good captive among them = chalkei nishmos Yisrael."**

intermediate.en: **"Hashem yispor bi'chsov amim, zeh yulad sham, selah"** (Teh 87:6): bi'chsov=via kesav; zeh yulad sham=good clothed in children (Rashi: Yisrael she'nitam'u b'akum).
intermediate.he: **"ה' יספור בכתוב עמים, זה יולד שם, סלה"** (תה' פז, ו): בכתוב=דרך כתב; זה יולד=טוב המתלבש בילדים (רש"י: ישראל שנטמעו באומות).

scholarly.he: תה' פז, ו (רש"י).

beginner.en: **"**'Lo yishkav ad yochal teref'** = mizbei'ach shleimus; **'v'dam chalalim yishteh'** (Tg: **'v'nichsei amma'ya yeiras'**) = **nichsei = ha'tov she'nis'kasah** — the good that was clothed (hidden in penimiyus machshavasam) that emerges via zera of the children = gerim → completing mizbei'ach."**

intermediate.en: **Bam 23:24 revisited**: "yochal teref"=mizbei'ach; "v'dam chalalim"="v'nichsei amma'ya yeiras"=**nichsei=ha'tov she'nis'kasah** (via holadah)=gerim.
intermediate.he: **במ' כג, כד שוב**: "יאכל טרף"=מזבח; "ודם חללים"="ונכסי עממיא יירת"=**נכסי=הטוב שנתכסה** (דרך הולדה)=גרים.

scholarly.he: ונכסי=נתכסה=גרים.

beginner.en: **"ח. The ma'amar: **Rav Safra mishta'ei: 'Zimna chada hava kazlina bi'sfinta, v'chazinan ha'hu kura d'afik reisha mi'maya, v'is lei karnei, v'chakik aleihu: ana beriya kalah she'ba'yam, v'havina shin parsa, v'azlina l'puma d'livyasan.' Amar Rav Ashi: 'Ha'hu iza d'yama havi, d'bachisha, v'is lei karnei.'"** — 'Rav Safra told: once we were going in a ship, and I saw a great **kura** (fish) that took its head out of the water, and it had **karnei (horns)**, and there was engraved on them: **'I am a light creature of the sea, and I am 300 parsa, and I am going to the mouth of the Leviathan.'** Rav Ashi said: that was a **sea-goat (iza d'yama)**, which digs with its horns; it has horns.' (Bava Basra 74a.)

intermediate.en: **Rav Safra / BB 74a**: **kura** (fish) raised head, had **karnei**, engraved: **"ana beriya kalah she'ba'yam, v'havina shin parsa, v'azlina l'puma d'livyasan."** R' Ashi: **iza d'yama** (sea-goat, **d'bachisha**=digs for food).
intermediate.he: **רב ספרא / ב"ב עד.**: **כורא** (דג) הוציא ראש, לו **קרני**, חקוק: **"אנא ברייה קלה שביים, והווינא שין פרסא, ואזלינן לפמא דלוויתן".** ר' אשי: **עזא דימא** (שעירת ים, **דבחישא**=חופרת במזון).

scholarly.he: ב"ב עד. — רב ספרא/עזא דימא/קרני/ש' פרסא/לוויתן.

beginner.en: **Rashbam**: **beriya kalah** = a small sea-creature; **l'puma d'livyasan** = that he will eat me today; **iza d'yama** = 'everything on land has its counterpart in the sea except the weasel' (Shechitas Chullin); **bachisha** = digs in the sea with its horns seeking food.

intermediate.en: Rashbam: **beriya kalah**=small sea-creature; **l'puma d'livyasan**=Leviathan will eat me today; **iza d'yama**=sea-analogue of goat (everything terrestrial has sea-analogue, per Chullin, except chulda); **bachisha**=digs with horns.
intermediate.he: רשב"ם: **ברייה קלה**=קטנה; **לפומא דלוויתן**=לוויתן יאכלני היום; **עזא דימא**=שעיר הים ("כל מה שביבשה יש בים חוץ מחולדה", חולין); **בחישא**=חופרת בקרניה.

scholarly.he: רשב"ם: ברייה קלה/לפומא דלוויתן/עזא דימא/בחישא.

beginner.en: **The Rebbe's peirush.** **"**Kura** = the **tov** — chalkei nishmos Yisrael + the gerim (above). Fish: **'asifasan hi taharasan'** (Chullin 27b) — bechina of chalkei ha'neshamos — **'rucho v'nishmaso elav ye'esof'** (Iyov 34:14); gerim = **'nedivei amim ne'esafu'** (Tehillim 47:10); chachamim called **'ba'alei asufos'** (Kohelet 12:11) — they **ma'asfim** the tov with the gerim."** **"**Afik reisha mi'maya** = extracts the **sechel** from the **shetifas ha'mayim ha'zedonim** = the **k'silus** flooding the sechel (as above)."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **kura**=tov=chalkei nishmos Yisrael + gerim (dagim "asifasan hi taharasan," Chullin 27b; "rucho v'nishmaso elav ye'esof," Iyov 34:14; "nedivei amim ne'esafu," Teh 47:10; chachamim="ba'alei asufos," Koh 12:11). **Afik reisha**=sechel extracted from **shetifas mayim zedonim**=k'silus.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **כורא**=טוב=חלקי נשמות ישראל+גרים (דגים "אסיפתן טהרתן", חול' כז:; "רוחו ונשמתו אליו יאסוף", איוב לד, יד; "נדיבי עמים נאספו", תה' מז, י; חכמים="בעלי אסופות", קה' יב, יא). **אפיק רישא**=שכל מוצא מ**שטף מים הזדונים**=כסילות.

scholarly.he: כורא=טוב (חול' כז:; איוב לד, יד; תה' מז, י; קה' יב, יא). אפיק רישא=שכל משטף הכסילות.

beginner.en: **"**V'is lei karnei, v'chakik aleihu** — **karna = tzedakah** = 'hon yosif rei'im' = **keren ha'kayemes l'olam ha'ba** (Monbaz, Bava Basra 11a: **'avosai ganzu l'matah, v'ani ganazti l'ma'alah'**). **Chakik aleihu** — via tzedakah a **chakikah** (engraving) is made = bechina of **kesav** (as above) = **'v'shom'o holech b'chol ha'medinos'** — reaching the **tov ha'kavush bein ha'akum**, arousing it to return. The good remembers itself."** **"**Ana beriya kalah she'ba'yam** = I am **above all worlds**. **Yam**: **mem = 4 olamos**; **yud = chochmah** expanding through all olamos — 'kulam b'chochmah asisa' (Tehillim 104:24)."**

intermediate.en: **Karnei** (on the fish)=**tzedakah**="hon yosif"=**keren kayemes l'olam ha'ba** (Monbaz, BB 11a "ganazti l'ma'alah"). **Chakik aleihu**=**kesav**="shom'o holech" → reaching captive tov. **Ana beriya kalah she'ba'yam**=above all worlds. Yam: mem=4 olamos; yud=chochmah expanding ("kulam b'chochmah," Teh 104:24).
intermediate.he: **קרני** (על הדג)=**צדקה**="הון יוסיף"=**קרן קיימת לעוה"ב** (מונבז, ב"ב יא. "גנזתי למעלה"). **חקיק עליהו**=**כתב**="שמעו הולך" → מגיע לטוב הכבוש. **אנא ברייה קלה שביים**=למעלה מכל העולמות. ים: מם=ד' עולמות; יוד=חכמה המתפשטת ("כולם בחכמה", תה' קד, כד).

scholarly.he: קרנא=צדקה/קרן (ב"ב יא.); חקיק=כתב; יים=ד' עולמות+חכמה (תה' קד, כד).

beginner.en: **"**Beriya kalah she'ba'yam** — as a **light** thing floats above, so the **neshamah = tov** is **above all worlds**."** **"**V'havina shin parsa** — the neshamah remembers it was **'Yisrael alu b'machshavah techilah'**, and HKBH took counsel with it in creating the world — **'heimah ha'yotzerim... im ha'melech bi'mlachto'** (Divrei Ha'Yamim I 4:23). She remembers she was at such a great height."** **"**Shin** = bechina of **machshavah** split into **3 heads**: machshavos sichliyos, machshavos midos, machshavos ma'asiyos. **Parsa** = regel = eitzah — 'v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha' (Shemos 11:8; = 'those drawn after your counsel'). The neshamah remembers she was in **machshavah** and He took counsel with her at briyas olam."**

intermediate.en: **Beriya kalah**=floats above=neshamah=tov above worlds. **V'havina shin parsa**=neshamah remembers "alu b'machshavah techilah" / "im ha'melech bi'mlachto" (Divrei I 4:23). Shin=machshavah (3 heads: sichli/midos/ma'asi); parsa=regel=eitzah (Shem 11:8 "b'raglecha"=counsel).
intermediate.he: **ברייה קלה**=צפה למעלה=נשמה=טוב למעלה מעולמות. **הווינא שין פרסא**=נשמה נזכרת "עלו במחשבה תחילה" / "עם המלך במלאכתו" (דה"א ד, כג). שין=מחשבה (ג' ראשים: שכלי/מידות/מעשי); פרסא=רגל=עצה (שמ' יא, ח "ברגליך"=עצה).

scholarly.he: שין=מחשבה; פרסא=רגל/עצה (שמ' יא, ח; דה"א ד, כג).

beginner.en: **"**V'hashta azlina l'puma d'Livyasan** = now (I) am heading to **kilayon v'hefsed, chas v'shalom** — and therefore have mercy on myself and arouse to return to root → **ba'alei teshuvah + gerim** (as above)."** **"**Rav Ashi: Ha'hu iza d'yama havi, d'bachisha, v'is lei karnei.** **Iza = oz = yirah** = bechina of 'ki tif'eres uzamo atah.' **D'bachisha** = the **tzaddik** constantly digging/searching for the hispa'arus in each Jew. **Is lei karnei** = **'u'vi'rtzoncha tarum karneinu'** = **ahavah** revealed via the tzaddik. All the above → revelation of the tzaddik's light → yirah + ahavah."**

intermediate.en: **Azlina l'puma d'Livyasan**=going to kilayon → mercy/return = ba'alei teshuvah + gerim. **Iza d'yama**=oz=yirah (Teh 89:18). **D'bachisha**=tzaddik digging for hispa'arus. **Karnei**="u'vi'rtzoncha tarum karneinu"=ahavah. All → tzaddik's light → yirah+ahavah.
intermediate.he: **אזלינן לפמא דלוויתן**=הולך לכליון → רחמים/חזרה = ב"ת + גרים. **עזא דימא**=עוז=יראה (תה' פט, יח). **דבחישא**=צדיק חופר להתפארות. **קרני**="וברצונך תרום קרנינו"=אהבה. הכל → אור הצדיק → יראה+אהבה.

scholarly.he: לוויתן=כליון; עזא=עוז/יראה; בחישא=צדיק; קרני=אהבה (תה' פט, יח).

intermediate.en: **"ט"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ט"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ט.

beginner.en: **The pasuk decoded.** **"**'Va'yehi heim m'rikim sakeihem'** = bechina of **'alvish shamayim kadrus v'sak.'** **Shamayim = yirah + ahavah**; **m'rikim sakeihem** = when they empty the sack (darkness) from yirah/ahavah. **'V'hinei ish tzror kaspo b'sako'** — **tzror kaspo = tzaddik**, as **'tzror ha'kesef lakach b'yado'** (Mishlei 7:20; Rashi: 'tzaddikim'). **B'sako** = the tzaddik's light clothed in sack/darkness. I.e., they realize the darkness on yirah/ahavah is because the **tzaddik's light is darkened**."** **"**Va'yiru es tz'roros kaspeihem heimah va'avihem** — they recognize that the darkness of the tzaddik-bundle depends on **chomer v'tzurah** = **heimah + avihem**. **Heimah** = the chomer (kelei ma'aseh). **Avihem** = the sechel (called **av** = 'av b'chochmah,' Megillah 13a). Revelation of the tzaddik's light requires **shleimus ha'ma'asim + zikus ha'sechel**."** **"**Va'yomer lahem Yaakov avihem** = **tochachas ha'sechel**, rebuking the **chomarim (kelei ma'aseh)** — attributing the defect to the vessels of action."** **"**'Osi shikaltem'** — via murky deeds he causes **kilayon v'hefsed to the sechel**. **'Yosef einenu'** = **'hon yosif rei'im rabim'** — the tzedakah. **'V'Shimon einenu'** = **'v'shom'o holech b'chol ha'medinos'** — done via hon yosif. **'V'es Binyamin tikachu'** = **'mizbei'ach b'chelko shel toref'** = **Binyamin** — for shleimus of sechel depends on this. The sechel says: the ikar lack of da'as depends only on **kelei ha'ma'aseh** = **tzedakah** — **'v'hayah ma'aseh ha'tzedakah'** (Yeshayahu 32:17) — tzedakah → gerim → mizbei'ach completed → sechel shalom → seeing the tzaddik's light → receiving yirah + ahavah."**

intermediate.en: **Pasuk decoded**: **"Va'yehi heim m'rikim sakeihem"**="alvish shamayim kadrus v'sak" (shamayim=yirah+ahavah; emptying sack/darkness). **"Ish tzror kaspo b'sako"**=tzaddik ("tzror ha'kesef," Mishlei 7:20 Rashi) clothed in sack. **"Va'yiru es tz'roros... heimah va'avihem"**: **heimah**=chomer/kelei ma'aseh; **avihem**=sechel ("av b'chochmah," Meg 13a). Light requires shleimus ma'aseh + zikus sechel. **"Va'yomer lahem Yaakov avihem: osi shikaltem"**=sechel's tochachah → kilayon sechel. **"Yosef einenu"**="hon yosif rei'im rabim"; **"Shimon einenu"**="v'shom'o holech"; **"V'es Binyamin tikachu"**=mizbei'ach shel toref; tzedakah ("v'hayah ma'aseh ha'tzedakah," Yesh 32:17) → gerim → mizbei'ach → sechel → tzaddik's light → yirah+ahavah.
intermediate.he: **פענוח הפסוק**: **"ויהי הם מריקים שקיהם"**="אלביש שמים קדרות ושק" (שמים=יראה+אהבה; ריקון שק/חשך). **"איש צרור כספו בשקו"**=צדיק ("צרור הכסף", מש' ז, כ רש"י) מלובש בשק. **"ויראו את צרורות... המה ואביהם"**: **המה**=חומר/כלי מעשה; **אביהם**=שכל ("אב בחכמה", מג' יג:). האור דורש שלמות המעשה + זכות השכל. **"ויאמר להם יעקב אביהם: אותי שיכלתם"**=תוכחת השכל → כליון שכל. **"יוסף איננו"**="הון יוסיף רעים רבים"; **"שמעון איננו"**="שמעו הולך"; **"ואת בנימין תקחו"**=מזבח של טורף; צדקה ("והיה מעשה הצדקה", יש' לב, יז) → גרים → מזבח → שכל → אור הצדיק → יראה+אהבה.

scholarly.he: פענוח: מריקים שקיהם=יראה/אהבה חשוכות; צרור כספו=צדיק (מש' ז, כ רש"י); המה/אביהם=חומר/שכל (מג' יג:); יוסף="הון יוסיף"; שמעון="שמעו הולך"; בנימין=מזבח של טורף; מעשה הצדקה (יש' לב, יז).
